capitalBridge.reserveClassification: Analyst assumption, not management minimum. Reserve approximately12.9% of FY2026 revenue, recognizing supplier inventories and cash needs; sensitivity2000–all unrestricted cash.
capitalBridge.debtPolicy: Face principal plus finance-lease liabilities once; book and fair values are alternatives, not additive. Finance-lease interest is financing and depreciation remains in EBIT. Future lease additions are included within normalized aggregate reinvestment.

operatingLeases.treatment: Keep operating lease cost in EBIT; do not additionally deduct as debt.

capitalBridge.latestCommonCountPolicy: Do not combine September shares with June cash/awards; proxy corroborates date difference.
capitalBridge.awardPolicy: Proxy exact maximum performance-award and option total is added once. Conservatively treat options as zero-exercise equity units, ignoring exercise proceeds. This is an upper claim approximation, not option fair value; a nonnegative-strike option cannot exceed the underlying share value. Full model has no duplicate option deduction.
capitalBridge.currentESPPClaimClassification: Analyst estimate only. Neither 150 nor the 70–300 stress range is measured fair value or a proven conservative bound. Conditional research use is accepted only with the estimate and sensitivity visible.
capitalBridge.currentESPPRationale: Current program unrecognized accounting compensation69.9, ten-month remaining amortization; actual purchase rights depend on purchase price and individual limits. Use150 allowance rather than falsely assigning zero or treating45.816m authorized shares as already granted.
capitalBridge.futureAvailablePolicy: Authorized future capacity is not currently outstanding and is not diluted.
capitalBridge.taxClaimPolicy: Conservatively deduct booked income/other tax payables once; those balances are excluded from operating NWC. GrossUTB864.149, disclosed uncertain-position liabilities762.4 and83.1 interest/penalties overlap and are not cumulatively added. Exact cash tax/other tax and interest mapping remains uncertain.
capitalBridge.dividendTreatment: June17 record date precedes June28 origin; July8 payment follows. This opening payable belongs to record holders and is deducted once from ex-distribution common-equity value. No future dividend or buyback is deducted from FCFF.
capitalBridge.deferredCompensationPolicy: Matched plan assets/liabilities offset; conservatively omit13.3 net residual asset pending tax/access analysis; do not add511.8 gross or subtract498.5 again. Verify allocation before removing the total liability from residual-other-liability reconciliation; its current sub-line is not disclosed. Forward economic margins are analyst assumptions, so historical plan-asset gains must not be added mechanically to forecast EBIT.
capitalBridge.NCIAndPreferredBasis: No preferred or NCI balance presented in FY2026 equity; not a claim about all historical periods.

omissions.reason: No exact current-right quantity or fair value is disclosed. The 150 allowance and 70–300 stresses remain analyst assumptions with no proven conservative-bound interpretation.

equityCompensationMethod.sensitivityPolicy: Hold non-SBC operating costs and physical reinvestment fixed. The recurring compensation ratio changes operating margin and implied terminal ROIC; it does not keep terminal ROIC fixed. Do not simultaneously add future-award dilution.

parameterRationale.revenue: Systems40% and support25% in FY2027 give31.274bn, belowSeptember guidance annualized32.4bn. Later growth fades; support includes Reliant and upgrades and is not modeled as guaranteed annuity. Base is an analyst continuation scenario; downside interrupts it.

parameterRationale.tax: 15% near-term exceeds FY26 GAAP12.07%; fades to21%. Malaysia15-year incentive effectiveFY2022 and other preferential regimes support low current tax but not perpetual current rate. FY26 tax reduction967.9m is reported evidence, not a recurring tax-asset addition.
parameterRationale.reinvestment: Adjusted latest identified investment diagnostic has sales/capital 2.067412 at FY2026 after adding 125.691 inventory-to-PPE transfers and 3.308 finance-lease additions. The older five-year core proxy 1.818 is incomplete and unadjusted. Initial 1.8 remains an analyst scenario, not an estimate fitted mechanically to either proxy. Opening capital-payable settlement is separately funded once.
parameterRationale.terminal: Base growth3% below adjustedUSD risk-free4.87%; margin32%, tax21%, next-period incrementalROIC18%; reinvestment16.667% ofNOPAT. Mature efficiency uses timing-adjusted same-periodS:C.
parameterRationale.claims: June capital basis is consistent. Maximum existing award units and zero option proceeds are conservative approximations; ESPP and unresolved claim allocations are explicitly accepted only as editable conditional research assumptions, not measured fair values or proven bounds.
parameterRationale.guidanceTrackRecord: Three recent quarters were within guidance; selected upcycle sample cannot justify a general reliability premium.
